G'oya

To'rtta qoida, har biri o'z cheklovi bilan: tashqi kalit CASCADE bilan, baho oralig'i CHECK bilan, "bir muallif, bir mahsulot, bir sharh" juftlik bo'yicha UNIQUE bilan, majburiy ustunlar NOT NULL bilan.

Yechim

CREATE TABLE reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  author TEXT NOT NULL,
  rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  comment TEXT,
  UNIQUE (product_id, author)
)

Namunada Azizning Choynakka ikkinchi sharhi rad etildi, Termosga yozgani esa o'tdi. Bekzodning 0 bahosi rad etildi, Dilnozaning sharhi Dazmol bilan birga o'chdi.

Tuzoqlar

author ning o'ziga UNIQUE qo'yish "har muallif butun do'konda bitta sharh" degani bo'lib qoladi:

Noto'g'riCREATE TABLE reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  author TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  comment TEXT
)

author dagi NOT NULL ikki ish qiladi. Muallifsiz sharhni taqiqlaydi, va UNIQUE (product_id, author) ni teshiksiz qiladi: NULL muallifli sharhlar bir-biriga teng hisoblanmaydi, ular istalgancha yozilib ketardi.
